reviews.comment: He seems like a kind man. But he is a really lousy professor. The logistics of the course were handled very poorly. He didn't put a single grade in canvas all semester. Also taught very little. All announcements were made last minute. I received a B and I have no idea what I got on the final or the project which combine for 50% of the course grade.

The professor lost my second exam and final exam. He does not respond to emails. I had to contact the co-director of ECEN, and they could only get him to email me back, but not find my lost exams. He claimed that I lied about even taking the 2nd exam, even though I have email proof confirming I did. Bad at using Canvas.

This guy needs to retire ASAP. He just reads off the lecture slides he stole from another prof and never wrote anything on them once. Thankfully class is graded very leniently so it's almost impossible to fail. I recommend finding a PDF of the textbook and doing the practice problems in them they really help. He is a good guy, but just a bad prof.

Extremely slow at posting homework and notes, leads to cramming a third of the semester into the week before the quiz and exam that aren't announced until the week before. Talks very slow making it hard to engage in lectures. Only graded on 2 quizzes 2 midterms and a final. Saving grace of this class was the extremely lenient grading.

Honestly not as bad as people said he was. The class itself has only 5 graded assignments (two quizzes, two midterms, and one final), all of which are in class and are very doable as long as you follow along with the lecture slides and do the (ungraded) homework. My only gripe was lack of Canvas communication, but he would communicate in class.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Entire grade is a total of 5 grades, two quizzes, 2 midterms, one final +10 pts. Have to write it in pen but he doesn't notice/care if you use an erasable pen. Very forgiving on grading those. Lectures can run-on a little as he'll talk about how X works. Great dude if you're trying to go into energy, if you're not, he can be a little nap inducing.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Absolute lazy professor, puts in zero effort in lectures. So lazy that he's using a different professor's slides and just yaps useless information during the lectures. HW's don't count toward your grade, but are still graded. Constantly forgets to put lectures slides on Canvas and homeworks too.

Goes on a lot of tangents in lecture, but they're pretty interesting if you like the material. Grading was a little unclear and the midterm kinda blindsided everyone, but he offered plenty of credit to compensate for it. Not the best structured class, but if you pay attention in lecture you'll gain a lot of practical knowledge of power systems.
He is a very terrible professor. espically in mentoring and grading. He need to retire as soon as possible.

Many mistakes in the lecture materials made it difficult to understand how to solve problems related to quizzes and exams. There is a project and presentation that counts for extra credit. Lectures are shared a week after covering in class and all assignments are on paper.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy
